context: Scene C spans frames 191-280 (rel 0-3.75s). Right-stage window x490-1060 y60-1020, thin border, three contiguous white artboard cells (570x960) in a vertical strip; page-turn legs ~0.12s at rel 1.20-1.32 and 2.40-2.52. All stroke geometry is real Baseline FUDE S01-S13 material. Each work now holds the finished piece ~12-13 frames before a ~0.3s color-separated proof flash (palette rotated per work), then runs per-stroke motion on the work's own finish and recomposes to a finished hold. Work01 near-black ink char, work02 cobalt-to-vermilion gradient char, work03 near-black two-wing emblem. Captions are one line each: 作例 01 筆墨 / 作例 02 筆彩 / 作例 03 筆構.
